pieces.Text: You are particularly adept at communicating with others via innuendo, gestures, and secret hand signs. You can hide somatic components of spellcasting.

You are particularly adept at communicating with others via innuendo, gestures, and secret hand signs. You gain a +4 bonus on Bluff checks made to pass secret messages. In addition, you are adept at hiding the somatic components of spellcasting. If you cast a spell that has only somatic components, an observer must make a Perception check opposed by your Sleight of Hand check to notice your spellcasting. Spellcraft checks made to identify any spell you cast that has somatic components take a -2 penalty.
